root_cause.text: In the `ccu_mix_trigger_fc()` function, a conditional check for the existence of a frequency change register (`common->reg_fc`) is inverted, causing the function to return early (skipping the trigger) when the register is present, instead of when it is absent.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (common->reg_fc)` to `if (!common->reg_fc)`, and the commit message states "Fix inverted condition that skips frequency change trigger, causing kernel panics during cpufreq scaling."
